blocks: Declared unitary PW row/phase transport and exact discrete Fourier frequency admission
Kinetic/local/nonlocal triangle bound without PW-square allocation or subtraction of squared norms
Independent dense first-principles oracle and sensitive mutations
Actual original-source full-PW action residuals on all raw columns and orthogonal-complement probes

formula.local: max abs(V_target - pullback(V_source)) + 2 eta max abs(V_source), eta=Frobenius norm of normalized Fourier embedding intertwining defect, computed columnwise analytically
formula.nonlocal_atom: C=U beta_source(atom_pullback), Q=declared angular intertwiner (default identity, never fitted), R=beta_target-C Q; bound=(normF(beta_target)+normF(C Q))*normF(R)*norm2(D_target) + normF(C)^2*norm2(Q D_target Q^dagger-D_source)
formula.total: sum of kinetic, local and all original atom nonlocal bounds
formula.precision: Analytic norm inequality evaluated in floating point, not an interval certificate. Action-probe maxima are empirical lower witnesses, not upper certificates.

checks: reject duplicate row/pullback maps, nonunit phase and antiunitary maps
omitting each individual positive bound term fails its isolated dense example

physical_factory_contract: substrate_framework.material_physical_operators.build_physical_factors(inputs,basis) -> existing PWFactors; settled factory SHA supplied explicitly at execution; no unfinished sibling bytes consumed or pinned here
scope: Same original source and spin, explicit original identity representative to selected unitary slots; H0 and actual initial K(delta n) frozen local stage separately. Rounded geometry unchanged. No nonlinear future-stage or finite-displacement/field symmetry inferred. Antiunitary conjugation does not license same-positive-time reuse.

reuse_policy: No automatic acceptance gate. A zero mathematical component bound entails exact covariance in the declared model; nonzero finite bounds permit only explicitly budgeted current-stage approximation (for Hermitian stages, propagator operator error <= abs(time)*bound). Floating output zero is not an exact-real proof. Moving stages require recomputation of actual current potentials, displacement and field transform conditions and all additional operator terms.
